title: Kissed Indian Semolina Pakora
description: A romantic and light Indian dish featuring roasted semolina, ideal for sharing or a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Cumin
ingredients.notes: Ground, or substitute with coriander powder.

ingredients.name: Coconut Oil
ingredients.notes: For frying, or substitute with vegan oil.

instructions: Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the semolina, gram flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt.
Add the ginger, cumin, and garlic to the dry ingredients and mix well.
Gradually add the water to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
The batter should still be slightly thick. If needed, add a little more water.
Cover the bowl with a damp cloth and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the batter into the hot oil, about 1-2 tablespoons each.
Fry the pakoras until they are golden brown and puffed up, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the pakoras from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate.
Serve the Kissed Indian Semolina Pakora hot with a dollop of yogurt, if desired.
You can also serve with a side of chutney or raita for added flavor.
Enjoy your delicious and romantic Kissed Indian Semolina Pakora!
For a raw-friendly version, use raw honey or maple syrup as a substitute for sugar, and be sure to handle the ingredients safely.
Be careful when handling hot oil and take necessary precautions to avoid burns.
